description: The figure contains two pie charts titled “All Changes” and “All Errors,” each showing the distribution of five categories (PW, R, RW, N, NW) with percentages labeled outside the slices and connected by leader lines; a legend on the right maps colors to labels (PW in light green, R in very pale yellow, RW in yellow with a darker outline, N in light blue, and NW in darker blue). In “All Changes,” there are five slices: PW (light green) at about 50%, R (very pale yellow) at about 26%, RW (yellow) at about 14%, N (light blue) at about 1%, and NW (dark blue) at about 5%; several slices appear slightly separated/offset from the center (notably RW, PW, and NW). In “All Errors,” there are also five slices: PW (light green) at about 56%, R (very pale yellow) at about 29%, RW (yellow) at about 6%, N (light blue) at about 1%, and NW (dark blue) at about 5%, with some slices again shown slightly exploded (notably RW and PW). Visually, in both charts the largest slice is PW, followed by R, with the remaining categories shown as smaller segments.
